concept: Foundation of the Indian National Congress
question: Who was the first Woman President of Indian National Congress?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Annie Besant**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Annie Besant** was the first woman president of the Indian National Congress.
 
• She presided over the Calcutta session of the Congress in 1917.
 
• Annie Besant was a prominent British socialist, theosophist, and supporter of Indian self-rule.
 
• Her presidency marked a significant moment in the Indian independence movement, highlighting the role of women in leadership.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sarojini Naidu** was the first Indian woman to be the president of the Indian National Congress, presiding over the Kanpur session in 1925.
 
• The Indian National Congress was founded in 1885 and played a crucial role in the Indian independence movement.
 
• The Congress sessions were important platforms for discussing and planning the struggle against British rule.
 
• Women leaders like Annie Besant and Sarojini Naidu contributed significantly to the political landscape of the time.
 
• Asaf Ali and Usha Mehta were prominent figures in the Indian independence movement but did not serve as presidents of the Indian National Congress.
